functions.name: cancel-audio-cleanup-request
functions.description: Attempt to cancel a pending audio cleanup request without deleting the original recording or completed media.

requestId.description: Opaque audio cleanup request identifier to attempt to cancel.

FunctionInput_veed_cancelaudiocleanupreq.description: The audio cleanup request to attempt to cancel.

id.description: The audio cleanup request identifier supplied for cancellation.

cancelled.description: Provider-reported cancellation success. False means unsuccessful; omitted means the provider gave no success flag, not that cancellation succeeded.

FunctionOutput_veed_cancelaudiocleanupre.description: The cancellation attempt and any provider-reported success indicator.

tags.instructions: Pass the id from `create-audio-cleanup-request`. Cancellation can be too late and is not a promise of a refund or deletion. Use `get-audio-cleanup-request` to inspect the outcome. A cancelled request has no promised undo; submit a new request if cleaning is needed again.

functions.name: cancel-avatar-video-request
functions.description: Attempt to cancel a pending audio- or text-driven preset-avatar video request. Cancellation is not deletion of a completed video.

requestId.description: Opaque avatar video request handle returned by an audio- or text-avatar creation tool.

id.description: The same opaque avatar request handle submitted for cancellation.

cancelled.description: Provider success flag: true means cancellation was reported successful, false means it was not. Omitted if the provider supplies no flag; omission is not success.

FunctionOutput_veed_cancelavatarvideoreq.description: The unchanged request handle and the cancellation success flag, when supplied by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use the id from either avatar video request creation tool. This attempts to stop pending work; it does not delete source audio or a completed video, and cancellation may be too late. Use `get-avatar-video-request` to inspect the outcome. Starting over requires a new request; no undo or refund is promised.

functions.name: cancel-talking-video-request

requestId.description: Opaque standard/fast talking-video handle returned by create-talking-video-request-from-audio.

FunctionInput_veed_canceltalkingvideoreq.description: The image-and-audio talking-video request to attempt to cancel.

id.description: The same opaque talking-video handle submitted for cancellation.

cancelled.description: Provider cancellation success flag if supplied. False is unsuccessful; omission means no flag was returned and must not be treated as success.

FunctionOutput_veed_canceltalkingvideore.description: The submitted handle and the provider cancellation flag, when supplied.

tags.instructions: Use the id from `create-talking-video-request-from-audio`; the handle retains its processing variant. This attempts to stop pending generation, not delete sources or completed output. Cancellation may be too late and has no promised undo or refund. Inspect with `get-talking-video-request`. Use text-specific cancellation for text-driven requests.

functions.name: cancel-video-audio-cleanup-request
functions.description: Attempt to cancel pending video audio cleanup without deleting source video or completed output.

requestId.description: Opaque video audio cleanup request identifier to attempt to cancel.

functions.name: cancel-video-processing-request
functions.description: Attempt to cancel a known Fabric text, lip-sync, subtitle, or background-removal request. Reports the provider's cancellation outcome without promising cancellation of work that has already advanced too far.

requestId.description: Opaque identifier of the processing request to cancel, scoped to the selected route.

processingType.description: Original processing route for this request. fabricText identifies the Fabric 1.0 text route; other values match submission results.

FunctionInput_veed_cancelvideoprocessing.description: Identify the known processing request and its original processing route to attempt cancellation.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the request targeted by this cancellation attempt.

cancelled.description: Provider's success flag: true means the provider reports successful cancellation; false means it reports no successful cancellation. Omitted when the provider does not supply an outcome; never synthesized as false.

processingType.description: Processing route targeted by the cancellation.

FunctionOutput_veed_cancelvideoprocessin.description: The targeted request and the cancellation outcome only when supplied by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use this to attempt stopping unwanted processing, not to delete a source video or finished output. Obtain requestId and processingType from submission or an existing Fabric text request record. Cancellation eligibility depends on provider state and can race with completion; it does not promise a refund or reversible pause. Use `get-video-processing-request` to inspect subsequent state or `get-video-processing-result` to retrieve any completed output. A missing cancellation outcome is not evidence that no change occurred.

functions.name: create-audio-cleanup-request
functions.description: Submit an audio or video recording for denoising into a 48 kHz mono 16-bit audio file, with optional loudness normalization.

audioUrl.description: Public URL or data URI of any audio/video recording ffmpeg can decode. A video's audio is used; multichannel input is mixed to mono. Maximum 30 minutes and 512 MB.

strength.description: Noise suppression strength. Lower retains more room tone beneath speech; silence between words is always fully cleaned. Suppression floor is 1 minus this value.

targetLufs.description: Output integrated loudness in LUFS (ITU-R BS.1770); default -19. Explicit null skips loudness normalization and retains input level. True peak is capped at -1.1 dBTP when normalizing.

outputFormat.description: Container for 48 kHz mono 16-bit output. FLAC is lossless and smaller; default flac.

FunctionInput_veed_createaudiocleanupreq.description: Recording source and optional noise suppression, loudness, and audio container settings.

id.description: Opaque upstream audio cleanup request identifier; use as requestId for inspection or cancellation.

status.description: Provider state acknowledged at submission; not a finished audio file.

queuePosition.description: Provider-defined queue position if supplied; omitted otherwise.

FunctionOutput_veed_createaudiocleanupre.description: Acknowledgment of the audio cleanup submission, not the processed audio.

tags.instructions: Use this when the desired output is audio, even if the source is a video. Use `create-video-audio-cleanup-request` to retain the picture. Sources may be up to 30 minutes and 512 MB. Pass targetLufs:null to retain input loudness instead of normalizing. Save the returned id for `get-audio-cleanup-request` or `cancel-audio-cleanup-request`. The tool only submits work; repeating it may incur another charge.

functions.name: create-avatar-video-request-from-audio
functions.description: Submit recorded speech and a preset avatar for asynchronous video generation. Returns a request identifier, not a finished video.

audioUrl.description: Provider-accessible audio URL containing the speech to animate; passed unchanged.

avatarId.description: Preset avatar and framing selection; any_* choices allow provider-selected avatars of the indicated category.

FunctionInput_veed_createavatarvideorequ.description: Existing speech audio and the preset avatar to animate.

id.description: Opaque avatar video request handle, including routing context; pass unchanged to request inspection or cancellation tools.

status.description: State observed when submission was acknowledged; completed does not itself include the video.

queuePosition.description: Provider queue position if supplied; indexing is provider-defined. Omitted when absent.

FunctionOutput_veed_createavatarvideoreq.description: Submission acknowledgment for asynchronous avatar video generation, not a finished video.

tags.instructions: Use this for a preset avatar speaking existing audio. For a written script use `create-avatar-video-request-from-text`; for your own image use `create-talking-video-request-from-audio`. Save the returned id and pass it as requestId to `get-avatar-video-request` or `cancel-avatar-video-request`. Submission does not wait for rendering, and repeating it can create another billable request.

functions.name: create-avatar-video-request-from-text
functions.description: Submit a script and a preset avatar for asynchronous video generation. Returns a request identifier rather than waiting for a finished video.

text.description: Ordinary Unicode script to speak. Whitespace and line breaks are preserved; no caller encoding is required.

avatarId.description: Preset avatar and framing selection; any_* choices delegate avatar selection within the indicated category.

FunctionInput_veed_createavatarvideorequ.description: A written script and preset avatar to submit for asynchronous video generation.

id.description: Opaque avatar video request handle including routing context; pass unchanged to inspection or cancellation.

status.description: State acknowledged at submission; does not establish that a usable video has been retrieved.

queuePosition.description: Provider-defined queue position if supplied; omitted otherwise.

FunctionOutput_veed_createavatarvideoreq.description: Submission acknowledgment and an opaque handle for later inspection or cancellation.

tags.instructions: Use this for a preset avatar speaking a written script. Use `create-avatar-video-request-from-audio` for recorded speech or `create-talking-video-request-from-text` for your own image. Save the returned id for `get-avatar-video-request` or `cancel-avatar-video-request`. Repeating submission can create another billable request.

functions.name: create-background-removal-request
functions.description: Submit a video for standard, fast, or green-screen background removal, preserving output codec and applicable extraction controls. Returns a processing request rather than waiting for the processed files.

mode.description: Extraction route. standard and fast use general foreground extraction; greenScreen selects the green-screen removal route. Omission selects standard.

videoUrl.description: Provider-accessible URL of the source video whose background should be removed.

outputCodec.description: vp9 returns a single video with alpha; h264 returns separate RGB and alpha videos and is recommended by the provider for better RGB quality. Omission selects vp9.

subjectIsPerson.description: For standard or fast mode only: whether the foreground subject is a person. Omission selects true; false supports non-person subjects.

refineForegroundEdges.description: For standard or fast mode only: improve the extracted foreground's edges. Omission selects true.

spillSuppressionStrength.description: For greenScreen mode only: strength from 0 through 1. Increase for remaining green spots and decrease for unwanted subject color changes. Omission uses 0.8; explicit null is forwarded without assigning additional meaning.

FunctionInput_veed_createbackgroundremov.description: Source video, extraction mode, output codec, and applicable foreground extraction controls.

id.description: Opaque request identifier to retain for later status, result, or cancellation calls.

status.description: Provider-reported request state at submission, not the processed files.

queuePosition.description: Provider-reported queue position when present, without an assumed index base; omitted if unavailable.

processingType.description: Selected processing route; pass unchanged along with id to related tools.

FunctionOutput_veed_createbackgroundremo.description: Asynchronous background removal acknowledgment for subsequent status, result, or cancellation calls.

tags.instructions: Use this to extract a video's foreground. Select standard or fast for general extraction, or greenScreen for green-screen footage. VP9 produces a single alpha-channel video; H264 produces separate RGB and alpha videos. Have a provider-accessible video URL. Save id and processingType, then use `get-video-processing-request` for progress, `get-video-processing-result` for files, or `cancel-video-processing-request`. Submission may start billable work and repeating it may create another request.

functions.name: create-lipsync-request
functions.description: Submit a source video and a new audio track for lip-syncing. Returns a processing request, not a finished video.

audioUrl.description: Provider-accessible URL of the new audio track to articulate.

videoUrl.description: Provider-accessible URL of the source video whose lip movements will be changed.

FunctionInput_veed_createlipsyncrequest.description: Source video and replacement audio URLs for a new lip-sync processing request.

id.description: Opaque processing request identifier; retain it for status, result, and cancellation calls.

status.description: Provider-reported state at submission; completed does not itself include the output file.

queuePosition.description: Provider-reported queue position when available; omitted if absent. No zero- or one-based interpretation is added.

processingType.description: Processing route to use with this request's identifier in related tools.

FunctionOutput_veed_createlipsyncrequest.description: Acknowledged lip-sync processing request, without the finished video.

tags.instructions: Use this when a video's speaker should articulate a new audio track. Have provider-accessible video and audio URLs ready. Save the returned id and processingType. Use `get-video-processing-request` to check progress, `get-video-processing-result` for the finished video, or `cancel-video-processing-request` to attempt cancellation. Submission can start billable work; repeating it can create another request.

functions.name: create-subtitle-request
functions.description: Submit a video for styled subtitle rendering, using automatic transcription or supplied SRT subtitles, with optional translation and style overrides. Returns a processing request rather than waiting for the rendered video.

videoUrl.description: Provider-accessible URL of the video to render subtitles onto.

preset.description: Style controlling fonts, colors, layout, and animation. Dynamic presets glass, whisper, glide2, fusion, glide, terminal, handwritten, backdrop, and backdrop2 have a 2x pricing multiplier; all other listed presets are basic at 1x. No default is chosen.

srtText.description: Ordinary SRT text, including cue numbers and relative timecodes. Skips transcription; mutually exclusive with srtFileUrl. Text is not base64-encoded.

srtFileUrl.description: Provider-accessible URL of an SRT file. Skips transcription; mutually exclusive with srtText.

vocabulary.description: Correct spellings and common transcription mistakes. Used only for automatic transcription; ignored with supplied SRT. An empty array supplies no corrections.

word.description: Correct spelling of a brand, product, or domain-specific term.

items.description: A misspelling to replace with the correct word.

replaces.description: Misspellings replaced by word, using whole-word case-insensitive matching. No need to enumerate casing variants.

items.description: A correct spelling and the transcription mistakes it replaces.

customization.description: Optional style overrides. Omitted fields retain preset defaults; an empty object changes no preset settings.

shadow.description: Shadow intensity for readability; none explicitly disables shadow and omission retains the preset.

position.description: Vertical placement of static subtitles; omit to retain preset placement.

textCustomizations.description: Overrides by word-importance tier; omitted tiers keep preset styling.

baseline.description: Styling applied to every transcript word before per-word emphasis.

font.description: Supported Google Font name. Unsupported fonts are rejected by the provider; omission keeps the preset font.

color.description: Text color as a three- or six-digit hexadecimal color with a leading #; omit for preset color.

weight.description: Font weight from 100 through 900; values at least 700 render as bold.

highlighted.description: Styling for automatically selected noteworthy words, such as key nouns and verbs.

font.description: Supported Google Font name. Unsupported fonts are rejected by the provider; omission keeps the preset font.

color.description: Text color as a three- or six-digit hexadecimal color with a leading #; omit for preset color.

weight.description: Font weight from 100 through 900; values at least 700 render as bold.

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the source audio, or supplied SRT when translating. Improves transcription accuracy; omission leaves selection to the provider. Not the output language.

translationLanguage.description: Target subtitle language; omit to keep the original language. For supplied SRT, also specify sourceLanguage for reliable translation.

FunctionInput_veed_createsubtitlerequest.description: Video, subtitle source, language choices, and preset overrides for one subtitle render.

id.description: Opaque subtitle-processing request identifier to use with related request tools.

processingType.description: Processing route for this request; pass it unchanged to related tools.

status.description: Provider-reported submission state; the completed file is obtained separately.

queuePosition.description: Provider-reported queue position if available, without assuming its index base; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_veed_createsubtitlereques.description: Acknowledgment of a subtitle-processing request, without waiting for the rendered video.

tags.instructions: Use this to render subtitles onto a video, including translation or supplied SRT. Have a provider-accessible video URL and select a preset. Dynamic presets cost 2x versus basic presets at 1x. Supply at most one SRT source; otherwise the provider transcribes the audio. Source language is not the translation target. Save id and processingType, then use `get-video-processing-request`, `get-video-processing-result`, or `cancel-video-processing-request`. Repeating submission may create and charge for another render.

processingMode.description: Generation variant. Standard uses the base model; fast selects the separately exposed fast variant. No numeric speed or quality guarantee is implied.

Submission does not wait for generation; repeating it can create another billable request.

functions.name: create-talking-video-request-from-text

Use `create-talking-video-request-from-audio` for recorded speech or `create-avatar-video-request-from-text` for a preset avatar. Save the returned id for the text-driven request status, result, or cancellation tools. This returns a submission acknowledgment, not a completed render; repeated submission may create another billable request.

functions.name: create-video-audio-cleanup-request

targetLufs.description: Integrated output loudness in LUFS (ITU-R BS.1770), default -19; explicit null skips loudness normalization. Normalized true peak is capped at -1.1 dBTP.

FunctionInput_veed_createvideoaudioclean.description: Video source and optional noise suppression and loudness settings for an asynchronous cleanup request.

id.description: Opaque video audio cleanup request identifier for inspection and cancellation.

status.description: Provider state acknowledged at submission, not a retrieved video result.

queuePosition.description: Provider-defined queue position when supplied; omitted otherwise.

FunctionOutput_veed_createvideoaudioclea.description: Acknowledgment of the submitted video audio cleanup request without waiting for its result.

requestId.description: Opaque identifier of the completed processing request, scoped to its original processing route.

processingType.description: Route used when this request was submitted. fabricText identifies the Fabric 1.0 text route; other values match submission results.

FunctionInput_veed_getvideoprocessingres.description: Identify a completed video processing request and its original processing route.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the request whose result was retrieved.

url.description: Provider URL from which this output file can be downloaded; no lifetime or permanence guarantee is added.

fileName.description: Provider-reported file name, preserved including null or an empty string; omitted when absent.

contentType.description: Provider-reported MIME type, preserved verbatim even if unexpected; null is preserved and absence is omitted.

fileSizeBytes.description: Provider-reported size in bytes without rounding or unit conversion; null is preserved and absence is omitted.

files.description: All output files in provider order. Single-video models return one element; background removal returns the provider's video array, without guessing RGB/alpha ordering.

processingType.description: Processing route associated with these output files.

FunctionOutput_veed_getvideoprocessingre.description: Downloadable output-file metadata for the completed processing request; no media bytes are downloaded.

tags.instructions: Use this after `get-video-processing-request` reports completed, or when you already know the request finished. Obtain requestId and processingType from submission or your existing Fabric text request record. This returns file URLs and metadata, not video bytes, and does not wait for unfinished processing. For progress use `get-video-processing-request`; to attempt stopping work use `cancel-video-processing-request`. Background removal can return more than one output; retain all files and their provider order.
